data.title: Yum! Brands executive pushes back against AI hate: Taco Bell drive-thru bot has helped increase employee retention by making jobs easier | Fortune
data.description: “I'm seeing all the data center noise and all the things that people worry about with AI, and there's that constant tension,” Yum! Brands Chief Legal Officer Erika Burkhardt said.
data.author: Sasha Rogelberg
